title: Polynomial Length Bound Under Pair Encoding
statement: Let $f$ map bit strings to bit strings, and suppose there are $C,c\in\mathbb{N}$ such that $|f(z)|\le C(|z|+1)^c$ for every bit string $z$. For $a_1,k_1,a_2,k_2\in\mathbb{N}$ and bit strings $x,r$ with $|r|=a_1(|x|+1)^{k_1}$, the polynomial length bound with parameters $a_2,k_2$ applied to the length of $f(\langle x,r\rangle)$ is at most the bound with coefficient $a_2((C+1)(a_1+3)^c)^{k_2}$ and exponent $(k_1+1)ck_2$ applied to $|x|$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps bit strings to bit strings
